en: Old sepia-toned postcard showing a large multi-storey academic building on a street corner, with ornate façades and many windows. A towered section is visible further back along the right wing. The front of the image has a printed Hungarian caption identifying the building. The reverse side is a standard divided-back layout with printed Hungarian legal notice and publisher imprint.
